messages.subject: Naming multiple, overlapping clade labels
parts:
Hi,

I'm hoping someone can help me with this. It.s quite simple so it should be quick but I can't seem to get it to work. I have two lists of node IDs to add clade labels with. I want to add a second list to show two alternative species delimitation schemes.

doing this doesn't seem to work

#testing clade labeling
test <- rtree(10)   #create random tree

tips1 <- list('sp1'=c('t1', 't2', 't3'), 'sp2'=c('t4', 't5', 't6'))   #create two sets of tips for species delimitation
tips2 <- list('sp3'=c('t3', 't4', 't5'), 'sp4'=c('t6', 't7', 't8'), 'sp5'=c('t9', 't10'))

nodes1 <- lapply(tips1, function(x) MRCA(test, x))   #get mrca nodes
nodes2 <- lapply(tips2, function(x) MRCA(test, x))

clade1 <- lapply(nodes1, function(x){geom_cladelabel(node=x, label=names(x), offset = 0)})   #create clade labels
clade2 <- lapply(nodes2, function(x){geom_cladelabel(node=x, label=names(x), offset = 1)})


ggtree(test) + geom_tiplab() + clade1 +clade2   #plot the tree with the labels

Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (1): label
Run `rlang::last_error()` to see where the error occurred.
In addition: Warning message:
`expand_scale()` is deprecated; use `expansion()` instead. 



Replacing names(x) with x seems to work, but then of course the clade labels will display only the node number. How do I actually set a proper name?

messages.subject: Re: Naming multiple, overlapping clade labels
parts:
Answered my own question it turns out.

test <- rtree(10)
nodes1 <- lapply(tips1, function(x) MRCA(test, x))

nodes2 <- lapply(tips2, function(x) MRCA(test, x))

clade1 <- mapply(function(x, y){geom_cladelabel(node=x, label=y, offset = 1)},  nodes1, names(nodes1), SIMPLIFY = FALSE)
clade2 <- mapply(function(x, y){geom_cladelabel(node=x, label=y, offset = 2)},  nodes2, names(nodes2), SIMPLIFY = FALSE)


ggtree(test,) + geom_tiplab() + clade1 + clade2
